reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the Ollama tool-result handling change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes Ollama tool-result handling in LLPhant so non-string results reach the model instead of prematurely ending the conversation. **Changes:** - Always creates tool-result messages, using existing content normalization for non-string values. - Adds a regression test verifying that array and integer results are sent in the follow-up request and the final answer is returned. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​Unit/​Chat/​OllamaChatTest.php` | Tests array and integer tool results and the final model response. | | `src/​Chat/​OllamaChat.php` | Removes the string-only restriction on tool-result messages. |
Review effort: Balanced
